title: Theme park world: can't buckle in my seat belt on roller coasters before they take off
content: It's been a reoccurring dream for me for years now. I'm usually with family at a dystopian Six Flags and all the rides are futuristic looking with huge drops and long loops and touching the ocean sometimes. As soon as I sit down on the roller coaster I can't get my seat belt to function and can't properly secure it in. I try waving down a ride operator to let them know I need help but then the roller coaster starts and I'm stuck panicking trying to get it properly buckled. After it takes off I'm holding on for dear life, screaming and scared as hell, but somehow I never fall out. So *far* I haven't fallen out. Has anyone else experienced this??
